entries.en: HM? WHO THE HELL ARE YOU? WHY[n]AREN'T YOU AT YOUR STATIONS?
IT'S NOWHERE NEAR BREAK TIME...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hold on—we're, ah...
We're salesmen.
We're new employees.
We're the Phantom Thieves!
SO WHAT? STATE YOUR BUSINESS[n]IMMEDIATELY.
THAT EXPLAINS THE OUTFITS!
APPREHENDING YOU CRETINS WILL[n]SURELY PUT ME ON MY SUPERIORS'[n]GOOD SIDE!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems like fighting him is our only[n]choice. Let's go!
I'm here for the chief director. You the
section chief?
THE CHIEF DIRECTOR?
HIS SCHEDULE IS PACKED TO THE[n]MINUTE! HE HAS NO TIME FOR[n]THE LIKES OF YOU!
HURRY BACK TO YOUR STATIONS—[n]UNLESS YOU WANT TO BE[n]DISCARDED.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, how exactly does someone get[n]"discarded"?
OH, ACCRUE ENOUGH VIOLATIONS[n]AND YOU'LL SEE.
I COULD TELL YOU EXACTLY HOW MANY[n]IF I WERE ACTUALLY TRACKING THEM,[n]BUT I'M MUCH TOO BUSY FOR THAT.
YOU DARE TAKE SUCH A DISRESPECTFUL[n]TONE? EVEN IF I'M NOT YOUR BOSS,[n]WE'RE MEETING FOR THE FIRST TIME.
NONE OF THAT MATTERS—JUST RETURN[n]TO YOUR STATIONS BEFORE YOU'RE ALL[n]DISCARDED.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's time for our next step, Joker—what[n]should we do?
Let's fight him.
We should leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, there's no need for any more[n]discussion. Take him down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you don't want to fight right now?[n]Then let's retreat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Phew, we're done with that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It doesn't look like he had anything,[n]unfortunately. It seems he wasn't[n]important, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh well... Let's check elsewhere.
UMMM, WHO'RE YOU AGAIN?
The Phantom Thieves.
Passersby.
We want to talk.
THE PHANTOM THIEVES, HUH?[n]I'M NOT INTERESTED. YOU'RE[n]JUST IN THE WAY OF MY WORK.
IS THAT SO? IN THAT CASE, THEN[n]HURRY UP AND GET LOST. YOU'RE[n]IN THE WAY OF MY WORK.
I HAVE NO NEED FOR THAT. NOW, GET[n]LOST. YOU'RE JUST IN THE WAY OF MY[n]WORK.
Please hear us out.
Are you the chief director?
You seem unenthusiastic.
THAT IS NOT NECESSARY. I HAVE NO[n]BUSINESS WITH YOU.
MORE IMPORANTLY, WHY AREN'T[n]YOU WORKING? IS IT SAFE TO[n]ASSUME YOU'RE SLACKING OFF?
HM? NO, I'M NOT THE CHIEF[n]DIRECTOR... PROBABLY.
BUT WHAT IF I WAS? JUST WHO[n]ARE YOU ANYWAY? ARE YOU[n]TRYING TO SLACK OFF?
OHOHO! MY ENTHUSIASM IS WHAT[n]MAKES ME WANT TO GET BACK TO MY[n]WORK.
MORE IMPORTANTLY, WHO ARE YOU?[n]I SHOULD REPORT EVERY LAST ONE OF[n]YOU FOR SLACKING OFF!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It is time we make our decision, Joker.[n]What do you want to do?
Let's fight him.
We should leave.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, there's no need for any more[n]discussion. Take him down!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So you don't want to fight right now?[n]Then let's retreat!
RUN AWAY WITH YOUR TAILS[n]BETWEEN YOUR LEGS. IT IS[n]FITTING FOR RATS LIKE YOU.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Serves you right, bastard! That takes[n]care of that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's got nothing on him though.[n]1000% waste of time.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems their physical size doesn't[n]necessarily correlate to their rank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The chief director must be somewhere[n]else... Let's try looking in another room.
